title: Better Combat Compat
description: Adds compat between Better Combat and many mods!
body:
**Description:**

This datapack* adds compatability between many mods and Better Combat by allowing many modded weapons to now work with Better Combat! Additonally this datapack* works on all versions and loaders of modded minecraft (that have better combat of course)

**Important Notice:**

*Keep in mind this is a datpack and not a resourcepack and can be more complicated to install and play with it is suggested to use a mod such as [Paxi](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/paxi) to make it simple.


**Supported Mods:**

- Witchery
- Species
- Savage and Ravage
- Mowzie's Mobs
- Hearth and Harvest
- Hazen 'N Stuff
- Dungeons and Combat
- Dungeon Now Loading 
- Cataclysm Spellbooks
- Blue Skies
- Aquamirae
